title: Irrationality of the 7-adic zeta value ζ₇(3)
summary: A complete Lean 4 / Mathlib proof that the 7-adic zeta value ζ₇(3) is irrational. Here ζ₇(3) = L₇(3, ω⁻²) is the Kubota–Leopoldt value, equal to the 7-adic limit of the Euler-corrected Bernoulli numbers −(1 − 7^{w−1}) B_w / w over the weights w = 6·7^{n+1} − 2. The same is proved for η = ζ₇(3)/2.
